description: The plot illustrates the loss of various models over the number of iterations, comparing their performance. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration", has a linear scale, ranges from 0 to 140000, and has tick labels at intervals of 20000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss", has a linear scale, and ranges from 2.4 to 3.4 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot displays six lines representing different models: Vanilla (purple, solid), StrmLLM (n=64) (blue, solid), SepLLM (n=64) (orange, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green, solid), SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red, solid), and SepLLM (n=128) (dark blue, solid). All lines exhibit a decreasing trend, starting from around 3.3-3.4 loss at 0 iterations and ending at approximately 2.5 loss at 140000 iterations, with a notable sharp decline in the initial 20000 iterations, followed by a gradual decrease thereafter; for example, the Vanilla model starts at around 3.35 loss and ends at approximately 2.48 loss, while StrmLLM (n=64) starts at around 3.36 loss and ends at approximately 2.63 loss.
